settings.title: Super-agent (experimental)
settings.description: A session pinned to the top of your session list: hand it several things at any time, and it runs the slow parts as parallel background tasks.
settings.switchDescription: When on, a "Super-agent" session is pinned to the top of the session list (same on desktop and mobile). It is a regular session: bring up several things at any time, and Super-agent hands the time-consuming ones to background tasks that run in parallel, then reports back in the session when they finish. When off, the session is hidden but its history is kept; turn it back on to restore it.
settings.safety: Background tasks use read-only tools by default; they never modify your data or run commands. They keep working after the window is closed to the tray and report back in the session.

config.instructionsDescription: Tell Super-agent in plain language what is worth handling and how. This is added to its system prompt.
config.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Only handle study-related requests; ask me before anything that would change data.

sidebar.deleteConfirm: A new empty Super-agent session will be created and background tasks will stop
